answer: Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. Trying costs an examination charge of £83, charged again each time a name fails a name, and the money is gone whether the name passes or fails. The farm's purse empties long before its list of names does. No Granted lookout astrolabe token, no seat: the rule is plain, and a token lookouts wear after glass inspections is why it holds. Every pearl is counted once. The velvet is checked, not assumed. One pigment, one entry.
